tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phur sgrub slob dpon gyi byed sgo zur 'debs dge/ swasti/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar phur sgrub mdzad pa'i tshes gcig chog bsgrigs tshogs grub pa dang / tshogs dpon gyis 'o phur sgrub chen mo'i chog bsgrigs kyi skabs 'dir sa chog nas bsgrigs dgos pas/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma tsam te/ sa sbyangs ba lha sta gon gyi bar dang / dngos gzhi ji ltar bltams pa nas/ mjug bkra shis kyi bar mdzad pa phyag len du gda' bas da lam yang mdzad par zhu zhes dang / bskul ris su yin gyis de bzhin byas nas/ bdag gi don yod dkyil 'khor bri'i bar/ ja mchod/ de nas oṃ badz+ra kro dha nas/ dam tshig la dgongs 'khod par gyur bar sta gon sgrig lugs dus phyis 'di las mi 'dug snga mo de'i 'phro nas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥbar mdzad 'dug ji ltar nas/ dngos grub thob bar bdag 'jug tshang ma/ de nas zhwa gyon/ skye med nas/ dngos grub rnam gnyis 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog bar/ rdor dril dung chos sogs kyi tshab phreng bas mdzad/ sngags dang 'don cha gsum yod pa rnams re re/ dper na ma tri dzaḥbazhi dgos rgyu la gcig gdangs gang yod bcas grub pa dang tshogs dpon gyi/ 'o 'di lo'i phur sgrub chen mo'i cho ga phyag len dbyangs rol gar 'chams dus chen skabs na bza' gzab spros mdzad dgos sogs so sor nas thugs 'khur bskyed pa'i bla ma gong ma'i dgongs rdzogs dang / sde bstan pa'i zhabs tog du 'gyur nges rang dgos rgyu yin pas de bzhin dang / 'chams sbyong dang dngos gzhi'i skabs thams cad du pad skor dang 'chams sna sogs du mdzad thams cad kyis 'chams dpon la gzigs nas zang zing du ma song ba zhig dang / da lta ka 'chams sbyong la hrug ste phebs pa zhu/ zhes dgyes nas 'chams sna bas 'chams gral tho sher grub cing / rol bsil rnga gral la 'khod grub pa dang bcom rol byas 'chams thon/ rdo rje nas keng rus bar gnyis re/

rin chen lnga las ma sgo bzhi kar mdzad/ 'chams ja dang po keng rus rdzogs mtshams/ gnyis pa gung gseng bcas/ byang bshags rdzogs mtshams/ gsum pa sbrul nag 'khyog 'gros rdzogs mtshams/ bstan skyong yongs rdzogs log mtshams/ zhwa rdor phor rnams tho sher rtsis sprod/ stang stabs hūm̐ ka ra gcig pu/ steng phyogs mnol yas bsdu/ mas bsdu/ kī la ya'i 'gros tshar gcig bla brang dang spyi pa'i ja zhus bla mchod dung gsal rnams so/ ༈ /tshes gsum la phur chung rnga brdung ma sgeg phreng glu gar la slob dpon ḍā dril bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol zer ba dang ja mchod pa ma thug na gtor ma byin rlabs mdzad par zhu zer dgos shing / thug na ja grub nas zer/ bdag gi don yon dkyil 'khor bri rdzogs nas dus phyis tshogs la mi bzhugs pas tshogs pas gsol ba chos spyod/ gsol ba grub nas chas bzhugs grub pa'i 'chams sna ba bsur byung ba dang phur khang du phyin chas bzhugs phyogs bzhi gsol gdab/ bgegs spros tshar gsum grub nas lho sgo brgyud/ mtshams rdo lho'i sgo nas 'byon srol gyi 'chams bzhugs pa'i rjes su dpon g.yog tsho phyin nas ra dpral ma btab na zhing steng btab na tshigs kha byang ma'i 'go gser skyems/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rigs 'dzin bskul bal po nas bal por bar shur ma/ rgya gar shes bzang nas dbyangs rol/ phur kha bsgyur ba/ de nas sa skya tshogs su 'chams dpon dbus su slebs pa dang pad 'gros bzhag khri shing 'khyil 'dug gi 'chams bshad rdzogs nas pad skor gcig rol 'gros sa gzhi 'khod snyoms nas dam nyams bla 'gug gsol ja btang / steng bar 'og byin rlabs/ rdo rje phyed brkyang tshar gsum re/ rgya gram gnyis/ e las nas keng rus bar tshar gsum/ gung gseng 'dus nas ja/ rin chen lnga las sgo bzhi 'gying chen nas yum chen bar ja grub nas/ phra phyag sgo ma byang gshegs bar/

gung gseng brgya tsho dpon ban tshang dbu byed/ grwa tshang mchod dpon bde gling dbu byed rnams mgron 'bod/ 'dus nas bya khra man bam len nas sbrul nag rdzogs pa'i ja grub nas 'chams sbyong bzhin/ phur khang zhal chen lhor nged rang mdzod pa/ ban tshang dbu byed gsum/ grwa tshang mchod dpon/ phyag mtshan 'khur mi rab 'byams pa/ gdug pa gang yod la dkar khung bzhugs gral ja gcig chab grub nas stang stabs/ phur gdab srung 'khor rtag chad mtha' gsal/ zhwa phod sogs bsdus/ chos grwar re zhig 'then tsam byas thog gral gdan sogs sgrigs grub nas dung gsal dgang dung bskang ba thugs dam ma shur ma/ nag rngam/ tshogs bsdus pa mjug chog rgyun bskang lugs/ tshes bzhi'i sta gon snyan gsan/ gung gseng 'dus nas bum bskyed mdzad pa zhu zer dgos/ lha rnams 'od du zhu bas bum pa'i chur gyur zer ba dang / gtor ma byin brlabs mdzad par zhu zer dgos/ tshogs gyes nas thig tshon byin rlabs dgong mo phur bkod la rak+ṣa'i rjes su oṃ badz+ra kī li sogs tshar cig rgyal chen tho 'dzugs bum 'bul/ bzod gsol byin rlabs gsol 'debs/ dngos gzhi dang por tshes lnga nas tsha do rbag thog yab rje kun dga' blo gros la mchod bsngo/ bdag 'jug grub nas gtor ma byin rlabs tshogs skad/ gnyis nas nyer dgu'i bar gsol chung grub nas bum bskyed tshogs skad/ ༈ /tshes bcu gnyis la sgro mo lung pa'i dgongs rdzogs/ gnyer tshang nas 'phar ja bsngo rten/ mchod dpon brgyud par mchod bsngo 'di rtsa ba rang dpon slob de nyid nas/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gi dgongs rdzogs phur sgrub nyin gcig 'phar ba de/ deng sang gnam gang gi 'di yin 'dug kyang mchod bsngo ni sgre mo lung pa mang thos bsod nams chos 'phel la mdzad/ ༈ /bco lnga'i gzhung ja rgyab ra'i thog 'jam mgon a mes zhabs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i dgongs rdzogs/

༈ /bcu drug gzhung ja'i thog de nyid sku mched rnams kyi yum dam chos rgyal sras mo lha sras bsod nams rgyal mor gshin bsngo/ ༈ /bcu bdun gzhung jar de nyid kyi jo lags sku 'phreng ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mchod bsngo/ ༈ /bco brgyad gzhung jar sku mched de dag gi yab sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'am/ mtshan gzhan ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por mchod bsngo/ ༈ /bcu dgu gnyer tshang du bla ma mchod dpon dkon mchog rgyal pos sbyor 'jags ja/ bsngo rten thog sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por mchod bsngo dang sbyin bdag mi brgyud shi gson la bsngo ste dbang stod bcu dpon pa yin pas gnyer dpon bsod nams dar po/ sde chung pa chos dbang bkra shis/ gnyer dpon bkra shis 'od zer/ grwa pa dbang phyug bkra shis/ sde chung pa rin chen phun tshogs/ rtsa gnyer tshe dbang rnam rgyal sogs 'brel thogs/ ༈ /nyer gcig la ni tshwa de log thog mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la mchod bsngo/ ༈ /nyer lnga'i gzhung ja thud 'bras sil thog 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por mchod bsngo/ ༈ /'di snga thog 'jam mgon a mes zhabs nas phyag mdzod bsod nams 'od zer gyi tshes mchod la mdzad 'dug kyang nged rang dran dus bsod nams dbang phyug dgongs rdzogs la 'gyur 'dug pa bzhin ma bsgyur bar bzhag pa yin no/ /bdag 'jug grub nas gtor bsngo'i tshogs skad/ nyer lnga'i gur drag gi spyan 'dren dung rkang gling dril rol rnam bzhag 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i rol yig nang bzhin rang dgos kyang nged rang dran dus mi 'dug de 'dra byed bsam yang sngar ma byung da mdzad nas dbyangs kyi rnga phog mtshams che ba re la ḍā ma ru'i sgra re dzar dang rol mo la ḍā dril bskal pa dang rang byung la slob dpon rang nas dkrol ba'i rol sil gang yin/

phyi nang mchod par ḍā dril/ dgug gzhug bskul dregs pa'i rol mo la g.yas rdo rje g.yon phur pa 'dzin pa'i lag gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang dbus brkyang / che mchog ma'i phyag g.yas la rdo rje bsnun tshul/ g.yon la phur pa bsnun tshul/ gnod byed la rdor phur chu srin rnam rol/ phyag rgyas bzung nas rol mo'i skabs g.yas g.yon dbus 'jog 'chams brdung phur sgril 'debs ral gri'i btub pa grub nas g.yas g.yon dbus su ling snod re bcas 'debs tshul mtha'i chems brdung la rdo rje thugs ka dril bu drag dkrol 'jog mtshams rol mo dang bstun pa mjug chog mchod pa ḍā dril bkra shis dril bsil rnams/ ༈ /nyer bdun rnga 'chams la bla ma rig 'dzin phur kha bsgyur ba nga rgyal bskyed pa/ rgyud gsum ma rnams dbyangs 'khor gnyis 'chams thang gnyis/ rgyud gsum dang por rtse gsum gcig gnyis par gnyis/ rdo rje phyed brkyang gnyis re 'chams gral du byon nas/ rgya gram gcig rnga 'chams grub nas nyung 'chams pa gsum/ hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin sh+lau ka gcig grub 'chams kyi thon 'chams/ 'chams dpon gyi dbus su skor cig rdzogs nas dgug gzhug tshar cig pad skor dzam/ seng ge'i brjid 'chams/ dang po'i mthar rkyang 'gro'i gnyis pa nas dred mo dang po bar nyis 'gros/ seṅge gnyis rdzogs nas ja/ ༈ /stag spyang dred rnams gnyis re/ dred mo rjes mar rkyang 'gros/ dgug gzhug med par chems brdung rol sil 'ber len sogs gdab tshul dang gnyis/ gung gseng ja/ gdab kha drug yas bsdu/ mas bsdu bzhi 'gros gri bskor ma/ brel dal re mos/ phyi nang gsang ba yas bsdu mas bsdu/ log 'chams 'bag rtsis bla brang spyi pa'i ja zhus/ phur dbang dngos gzhi yod skabs dang / nyer brgyad nas tshes gcig bar che ba'i yon tan shur ma phur dbang yod na sgrub mchod grol nas sku rim med sgrub/ dpung skud gsol ba chos spyod skabs 'degs/

nyer brgyad sgrub mchod grol nas nyer dgu'i dung gsal dur khrod bdag po'i 'chams rgyug nyer dgu'i gtor bsngo rdzogs nas tshogs stsal du gsol gyi rjes su gsum brdeg len can/ gsol ba chos spyod sogs grub nas chas su bzhugs/ lho sgo nas 'byon pa byings kyi bya khra ma'i shar bar rnga rtse g.yon bstan/ de nas g.yas bstan/ bla ma rig 'dzin nas rgyud gsum ma'i bar/ rdo rje phyed brkyang rnam gsum rgyud gsum ma dang por rtse gsum gcig gnyis pa dang gsum par gnyis te/ bla ma rig 'dzin gsum rdzogs nas ja/ rgyud gsum ma gnyis rdzogs nas ja/ phyir rgya gram gnyis log 'chams/ nor skyong 'chams pa/ mchod dpon/ bam 'dzin rnams la bka' bsgo/ ༈ /tshes gsum ltar mgron 'bod/ nor skyongs chas bzhugs grub pa'i brda' byung ba dang / gser skyems bla ma rig 'dzin/ rig 'dzin bskul ra pho dpral bar mdzad pa bzhin/ phur kha bsgyur bar 'chams dpon lho gzigs/ lha srung spyan 'dren la byang gzigs/ de'i sngags phyag la lho gzigs/ nga rgyal bskyed par byang gzigs/ de'i sngags dang dāsti la lho gzigs/ rgyud gsum la byang gzigs/ rgyud gsum ma'i mtha'i dgu rdung mthar gsum brdeg len can/ de nas slob dpon rol sil rnga gral shar gzigs/ dung rgya gling nub lta/ bcom rol nyung 'chams dang po/ dur khrod bdag po/ nyung 'chams gnyis rnams grub nas gyes chas zhugs grub pa dang gong gi zhal lta phyogs de kas hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin dbyangs rol tshar gsum rdzogs pa'i chems brdung la 'chams sna ba thon song ba dang / 'chams khang nas chas slob dpon gyis rkyang 'gros liṅga'i mtha' 'khor ba dang / rnga rol sgra bzhag rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad phyag rgya dang bcas rnga dpon la gsal byas pa'i dgug gzhug chems rdung / 'jog mtshams rol dpon la gsal byas pa gsum gyi rjes mar tshe srog ye shes su bsgyur ba grub nas bhan ral thog pa'i 'bag dkrug ci rigs mthar/

gcig ge gnyis gsum mo bzhi zhes dang / pad skor dzam lnga rkyang 'gros pad skor seṅge brjid 'chams gsum gyi dang por brkyang 'gros gnyis pa gnyis la nyis 'gros ja/ stag mo nas dred mo bar gsum re'i dred mo gnyis rdzogs nas gung gseng / 'dus nas ja/ dred mo rkyang 'gros/ dgug gzhug gcig tshe srog ye shes su bsgyur ba ma dgos bhan ral thor nas 'bag dkrugs ci rigs mthar 'ber len shus 'gros bcas g.yas skor dgu'i bdun la g.yas phab lcags 'then gnyis/ bzhi 'gros gris bskor brel ba gdab tshul gnyis/ bzhi 'gros gri bskor dal ba ja/ gtso phur thogs nas gdab ka dang po khro bcu kun 'dus phur pa thogs nas 'bag dkrugs 'ber sogs gong bzhin 'gros brel ba phur btab grub nas phra phyag sgo ma kun 'dus phur pa 'bag dkrugs sogs gong bzhin bzhi 'gros dal ba phur btab grub nas lcags ral 'bag dkrugs bzhi brel ba gung gseng / sku mgron phul rjes 'dus nas ja/ ral gris btub nas thun du sogs 'bag dkrugs bzhi 'gros dal/ thun brdeg tho ba thog nas 'bag dkrugs bzhi 'gros brel ba/ tho brdung grub nas ral gris btub/ ban ral 'chams gral 'chams 'go 'chams gzhug mtshams su phyi nas dmar dgyed ma grub bar la 'bag dkrugs grub pa dang / 'ber len g.yas bskor g.yon bskor gcig gnyis zhes bzhag nas phyi nang gsang ba ling ro gtor grub nas 'chams 'char gyi sner myur stabs kyis rgyug dzam bzhi 'gros gri bshags kyi log nas 'chams gzhug pa 'cham skabs bse theb gyon nas chas te ka khong bzhugs gral tshes gsum bzhin 'chams chas bzhag dgong dung bskang gso sogs 'phros/ tsher mi dgos/ gnam gang la gtor bsngo rdzogs gsol chung gsol ba thugs dam ma 'go dbyangs 'bul sngags sogs rdzogs nas ja mchod tshogs bshags rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can mi dgos/ gung gseng / lhag ma rgyas pa 'bar ma'i mtha' chems brdung la dpon slob la rol bsil yod na bzhag nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya kha bkru yang rol bsil dkrol ba lhag ma grub nas spyi stabs sogs so/

༈ /tshes gcig bskang ba grub nas gsol ba grub pa'i bzang spyod rjes/ bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog zer ba dang / 'o 'phar lo gang yin gyi ming spos ba zhes pa'i lo 'dis skyabs mgon rnam gnyis sogs bla ma gong ma'i dus dran mchod 'bul dang bstan pa spyi rim phur sgrub chen mo mdzad skabs dbyangs rol 'chams cho ga phyag len phra mo tshun la so so nas thugs 'khur bskyed pas bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs shing sde bstan pa'i zhabs tog 'gyur nges lags pas shin du legs shing bshad las pas kyang dam pa gong ma'i gsung rab legs bshad kyi skyes ngo mtshar gyi gnas su gyur pas des na da lam gtor 'bul gyi skabs sogs 'phros 'di la'ang kun spyod legs shing thugs rtog gang zhib zhu zhes brjod nas lha khang rtser pu tra bskul ja ja mchod spyi bstab/ bstan skyong srid zhi dpal 'byor/ phyogs skyong gshegs gsol/ slob dpon rdor dril phur khang du dkyil 'khor bskor ba lan gsum grub nas gral la 'gro ba dang dung gsal rol mo bzhag nas phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa thal sbyar ye shes lnga ldan gdangs dang po ring ba bar pa de las thung tsam/ rjes ma de las kyang thung tsam/ bsngo ba yig brgya ma 'byor ba tshigs bcad lhug brtan bzhugs gshegs tshig dkyil chog nas 'byung ba/ oṃ khyed kyi phyag rgya bcas gdangs ring gnyis/ gdangs thung gcig slob dpon rdo rje thugs ka dril bu rgyun chags rol mo gzhan rnams kyi sgra bcas byung ba dang / mchod dpon gyi dkyil 'khor la phul ba'i rnam rgyal las bum bsdus slob dpon gyis rdo dril bzhag nas shar gyi dbang phyug ma'i phur pa dang po nas g.yas bskor gyi byang shar phur pa'i bar bsdu bar phur gdan la btsugs pa de phyung nas phur gdan gzhan bsdud bcug grwa'i bum dung bzhi mchod dpon pas bsdus/ shar nas bzung sgo ma'i phur pa hūm̐ mdzad phur pa nas rta mgrin bar/

nub byang nas byang shar bar/ nub g.yon stobs po che'i phur pa bsdus nas gtso phur gyi sku mdun du phyin nas de bsdus ste thams cad phur gdan las nges par dbyung dgos/ dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa rdo rje'i rtses shig shar nas bzung g.yas bskor gyi phyogs mtshams thig steng phyi nas nang du rdo rje rtses 'then pa dbus su slebs pa byas nas rdo rje thugs ka dril bu rgyun chags/ gzhan gyi snam ras gtsang mas dkyil 'khor mtha' nas dbus su bsdus rdul tshon snod gzhan du blug tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyi las bum gyi chu thig ris la bran nas gzhan gyi de phyi skabs slob dpon gral la byon nas dung gsal rol mo bzhag oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sogs nas 'dra ba las/ bkra shis rgyas par brjod cing me tog gtor te nyin bde sogs kyi rol mo dang bstun shis nas mchod dpon gyi snod du yong bar byas la grol dung grub pa'ang mchod dpon gyi phur btab bcu/ rgyal chen sku thang bsdus ma ka drung gi gdan steng du rol rtses/ gos ber phod gong theb rnga 'bag phyag mtshan rtses blang nas log sang lha khang rtser bsang bskang gso gong bzhin ga ya dha ra'i bum chu la phur sgrub bum chu'i phud phul/ tshur zhus yang phud phar slog sang nas bzung mgon khang lnga'i gtang rag bya'o// //zhes sa skya pa kun blos rang gi bu rgan pas phur sgrub tshogs dpon mdzad skabs 'di 'dra dgos gsungs pa bzhin bris pa phyogs dus kun du dge/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ phur sgrub slob dpon gyi byed sgo zur 'debs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
